svg.title: mosali: season 1448 density map
svg.desc: 43 living individuals, aggregated into a 24 by 16 grid. Top-left origin; map edges wrap. Counts describe one observation, not a habitat preference.

g.text: Each cell: 40 × 40 simulation units. Numbers: bodies present.
Blank cells: zero at this moment. Darker green: higher count.
Edges wrap · no terrain overlay · not a species range or causal explanation
